purpose: Make every valid ElizaWy, Universal LPC, and curated OpenGameArt LPC source asset discoverable, attributable, semantically classified, and eligible for explicit promotion without copying every raw source permutation into runtime builds.

providers.role: primary Havenwild world, structure, object, effect, and LPC Revised character art authority
providers.policy: immutable pinned dependency; editor may browse complete catalog; runtime requires stable IDs, source rectangles, footprint/animation metadata, license context, and explicit semantic promotion

providers.role: complete character body, appearance, clothing, equipment, tool, weapon, shield, and animation extension
providers.policy: all compatible options exposed through source catalogs; runtime packages selected/generated composites and required layers rather than all raw permutations

providers.role: licensed LPC-compatible gap coverage for structures, cliffs, caves, farms, docks, ships, nature, creatures, items, effects, and animations
providers.policy: collection membership is never license approval; only exact files with verified authorship, selected license, derivative chain, hashes, and credits may be promoted

states.source_verified: Pinned or hashed source and complete index are available.
states.catalogued: Source is indexed with stable provenance but not yet semantically bound.
states.promotion_candidate: License and broad role are acceptable; footprint, compatibility, or source-rectangle work remains.
states.runtime_promoted: Stable runtime/editor ID and complete metadata exist and validation passes.
states.quarantined: Known wrong role, incompatible geometry/style, incomplete attribution, duplicate, or prohibited license.
states.blocked_missing_source: Committed catalog exists but the raw pinned dependency is not currently mounted.
states.reference_only: Documentation, test scene, preview, or visual reference that is not gameplay content.

priorityLanes.reason: Blocks elevation, caves, and coherent regional traversal.
Replaces Z84 invisible reservations with authored capital and port content.
Enables functional buildings and business gameplay.
Completes biome, farming, harvesting, and world-dressing coverage.
Makes the complete compatible character repository available through normalized choices rather than a starter subset.
Certifies visual layers and timing against actual gameplay actions.

knownQuarantine.reason: Modern water cooler was visibly misclassified as Willowmere's well in Pass167Z83.
knownQuarantine.requiredRepair: Remove ObjectKind::Well binding and promote a period-appropriate well or fountain separately.

releaseRule: No runtime asset may depend on a machine-local junction. Pinned dependencies may remain external authoring inputs, but every shipped asset must be a validated generated cache or promoted project asset with complete credits.
